Un resultado es óptimo de Pareto si no s: An outcome is Pareto optimal if no one can be made better off without making the other worse off. A Nash equilibrium need not be: in the prisoner's dilemma both confess because it is the best each can do, even though both would be better off if they stayed silent. The same happens with two firms that cut prices, or with countries that do not reduce their emissions.
